messages:
Rachel: FYI I'm kicking off a staggered bring-up for rwd-v3.3-int4-lite in hosted. Quick heads-up: great cost numbers but one worrying signal on long-doc MRR and a small uptick in code-block truncation. Posting proposed gating rules for feedback.
Tom: Which eval slices are flagging? numbers?
Rachel: Long-doc (>3k tokens): MRR -2.4% vs rwd-v3.2-fp16 baseline. Code fence slice: more frequent early stop tokens in nested fences. kv-warmup hit-rate down to ~72% in sim. Entropy distribution shows a right-shift on a small cohort (z ~ 2.3).
Vincent: Oof. Int4 wins cost but those fidelity deltas on long docs are risky. Suggest adding a token-normalized fidelity metric so long-docs don't dominate.
Nina: Agreed. We created "fidelity_slope" in the eval infra: delta_MRR / sqrt(mean_token_count). It compresses long-doc weight but still surfaces regressions. Proposed numeric gates: fidelity_slope > 0.8 -> hold, > 1.5 -> immediate rollback. kv_hit_rate < 80% -> hold, < 60% -> rollback. Entropy_zscore > 2.0 (1h window) -> hold.
Tom: Love the fidelity_slope idea. Also propose symmetric rollback behavior: partial slope-back to previous candidate at 10% steps for transient blips, but full rollback to last-pinned if thresholds are exceeded twice in 24h.
Rachel: Draft canary YAML (putting everything together):
```yaml
canary:
  start_pct: 2
  max_pct: 15
  ramp_hours: 72
  min_hours_at_step: 6
  shadow_compare_pct: 100

gates:
  fidelity_slope_thresholds:
    hold: 0.8
    rollback: 1.5
  kv_hit_rate_thresholds:
    hold: 0.80
    rollback: 0.60
  entropy_zscore_hold: 2.0
  hallucination_pct_increase_hold: 0.4

actions:
  slope_back_steps: [10,5]  # in percent
  full_rollback_after: 2 # holds in 24h
  circuit_halt_after: 3 # holds total -> pause canary and alert SRE
  rollback_to: rwd-v3.2-fp16
  require_promotion_approval_if_cost_win_lt: 0.18 # 18%

monitoring:
  eval_frequency_minutes: 120
  slices_to_report: [long_doc, code_fence, legal_qna]
```
Vincent: Couple operational asks: 1) Emit per-slice fidelity_slope so we can weight by customer impact; 2) Log top 10 failing prompts on any hold; 3) kv-cache warmup heatmap + per-instance hit-rates.
Rachel: Yep. Will add the heatmap and top-10 prompt logging. We'll push the canary config to infra repo and wire dashboards.
Tom: What about auto-promotion?
Nina: Promotion guard: require cost improvement >= 18% AND no fidelity_slope hold-level hits across critical slices for 72h. Otherwise require manual approval. Also require shadow-compare parity <0.2% diff on key metrics (MRR/hallucination) for 48h.
deploy-bot: Canary created by rachel 1724223333? (meta) start=2024-06-14T08:00Z canary_id=c-1722223333 target=/models/rwd-v3.3-int4-lite initial_pct=2
Vincent: Small nit: deploy-bot timestamp looks odd, but config scheduled. One more: add a transient-lock to prevent overlapping canaries on the same model route.
Rachel: Will enable model-route lock. Scheduling runs now and will post first eval snapshot here in ~2h. Thanks all. :rocket:
